title: One Hundred Wins in 131 Games
sources: FC Barcelona, 'Hansi Flick: Record-breaking 100 wins', 31 October 2026: https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4601449/hansi-flick-record-breaking-100-wins
FC Barcelona, 'FC Barcelona 6-1 Alavés: That's more like it!', 31 October 2026: https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4602177/fc-barcelona-6-1-alaves-thats-more-like-it

scenes.text: One hundred wins for Barça. Hansi Flick reached the mark in just one hundred and thirty-one games.
Only Luis Enrique got there faster: one hundred and twenty-six.
Flick's century arrived Saturday, in a six-one win over Alavés.
It followed back-to-back defeats to Paris Saint-Germain and Real Madrid.
Barcelona scored four before half-time, then added two more after the break.
The opener was a team move: fifteen passes, involving nine players.
Fermín López scored once and assisted twice.
With six players unavailable, including four defenders, Brian Fariñas debuted at right-back.
His win rate: seventy-six point three three percent, the highest in club history.
A hundred wins in one hundred and thirty-one games. What comes next?
